title: A Chance Encounter
next_chapter_hook: The moment the token touched his palm, the three characters 'Tianji Pavilion' struck like thunder—why would this mysterious force, existing only in ancient legends, intersect with the childhood of atrash servant disciple?

text.content: As the spatial rift closed gently behind him, the moment Chen Ji stepped out of the secret realm, the world seemed to fall into sudden silence. The dying warning from his protective spirit beast still echoed in his ears, and the words 'Eyes of Heaven' were like a tiny thorn, pricking the softest spot in his heart. He took a deep breath of the crisp mountain air, trying to calm the inexplicable restlessness churning in his chest. In the distance, the outline of Tianqing Sect loomed hazily through the misty clouds, with wisps of cooking smoke rising—it appeared completely ordinary. But Chen Ji knew that beneath this tranquility, undercurrents surged. What he had glimpsed was merely the tip of the iceberg.

As he was about to leave, Chen Ji's footsteps suddenly froze. A familiar aura, deeply ingrained in his very marrow yet terrifyingly foreign, flooded into his perception without warning. That aura was aged and gentle, like an ancient scroll gently opened, releasing the fragrance of沉淀 over time. He spun around sharply, his pupils contracting to the size of needle points—Impossible, this sensation... He下意识 clenched his fists, his knuckles whitening from the force, yet his heartbeat accelerated uncontrollably. The page of the Tianji Record containing Mr. Mo's residual soul was faintly burning hot.

dialogue.content: (Mr. Mo's voice rang out in his Mental Sea, carrying a rare gravity) Chen Ji, stay calm. That aura... something's off, yet it feels strangely familiar. I've been sleeping within the Tianji Record for too long—I can't immediately identify which divine being this is.

text.content: Before his words finished, the void rippled slightly, and a figure materialized凭空 three zhang away. The newcomer had pure white hair and beard, wearing a faded blue robe that fluttered in the wind. His face was aged but his eyes burned with intensity, seeming capable of piercing through all illusions in the world. Deep within those eyes lay a depth and compassion Chen Ji had never witnessed. His aura was restrained to the point of near nihility, yet Chen Ji distinctly felt an overwhelming pressure—like standing before a towering mountain—this was a supreme master, with cultivation depth immeasurable, incomparable to any elder in Tianqing Sect.

dialogue.content: (The old man slightly nodded, his voice aged yet gentle) So you're Chen Ji? Indeed, as he predicted, you've grown into such a模样.

text.content: Chen Ji's heart was shaken剧烈, yet his expression remained calm. Instead, he forced out his usual timid smile and bowed respectfully: 'Elder must be mistaken? This小子 is merely a servant in Tianqing Sect—why would an elder specially wait for someone like me?' His voice trembled slightly, his acting flawless, but his hand hidden in his sleeve had alreadyquietlytouched the Tianji Record Fragment. This old man's appearance was far too suspicious, his timing too precise—as if he had been waiting for him from the very beginning.

dialogue.content: (The old man轻笑一声, with a trace of nostalgia in his smile) Mistaken? The cold pond drowning fifteen years ago—do you truly not remember? If someone hadn't pulled you out, your天生绝脉trash体质 should have turned to dust long ago.

text.content: These words struck like thunder into his mind, Chen Ji's pupils dilated sharply. The cold pond drowning... that happened when he was seven. Back then, fellow disciples had pushed him into the cold pond deep within the sect's Forbidden Grounds, and he had waited despairingly for death. When a pair of warm hands pulled him above water, his memory after that became extremely blurred. He only remembered someone gently tapping his Brow Center, and then he completely lost consciousness. After waking up, he thought it was all a dream and never mentioned it again. But how does this old man know about this? Could it be...

(Mr. Mo's residual soul oscillated violently) Interesting... fifteen years ago was precisely the year I fell into slumber. The force of that finger tap matches thefluctuation frequency of the Tianji Record exactly. Chen Ji, this old man is lying—or rather, he's omitting certain critical information. The person who saved you was no ordinary cultivator.

Chen Ji's mind raced, but his face showed a sudden realization, then shifted to an expression of overwhelming gratitude: 'So it was... it was the elder who saved this junior's life! All these years, this junior thought it was merely a dream—never imagined it was real.' As he spoke, his eye sockets faintly reddened, his acting skills bordering on mastery. In his heart, he was rapidly calculating: the foreshadowing laid in Chapter Seven finally paid off at this moment.

text.content: Chen Ji心里默念, spiritual energy subtly flowing within his body. The Tianji Record Fragment faintly burned hot within his Mental Sea, yet in the next instant, that familiar foresight power struck an iron wall—images chaotic and blurred, as if viewed through a layer of water. He only vaguely glimpsed the old man handing over a token, then his figure dissipated in the wind.

dialogue.content: (Mr. Mo's voice rang out, carrying a hint of gravity) Did you see? This person carries arestriction that interferes with Heavenly Secrets power. Ordinary people could never accomplish this—his origins... are far more terrifying than you imagine.

text.content: The old man seemed to see through his小心思, yet didn't expose them, merely smiling faintly. That smile carried traces ofbenevolence and melancholy, like an elder watching a youngster's mischief—helpless yet indulgent. 'You are more exceptional than I imagined.' He slowly said, 'Being able to conceal your true nature for so many years in Tianqing Sect without revealing any flaws—merely this quality of mind and heart already surpasses countless prodigies.'

dialogue.content: (The old man took out an ancient token from his sleeve—the front side unmistakably bore three seal script characters—Tianji Pavilion) This thing, you keep it. When the time is right, it will tell you everything.

text.content: Tianji Pavilion! Chen Ji's heart was掀起惊涛骇浪. He had seen these three characters several times in ancient fragmented texts, each time accompanied by words like 'unverifiable' and 'annihilated in antiquity.' Tianji Pavilion—that was a mysterious organization supposedly long vanished from history's river. Legend said they controlled supreme secret methods for deducing Heaven's way, could foresee good and bad fortune, even intervene in dynasty changes and sect rises and falls. If this was true, this old man's identity was absolutely no ordinary matter.

(Mr. Mo's residual soul trembled violently) Tianji Pavilion... so that's how it is. I should have realized earlier. For someone capable of delivering the Tianji Record Fragment to you, how could they be an ordinary person? Chen Ji, you must accept this token, but remember—unless absolutely necessary, never proactively reveal any connection to Tianji Pavilion.

Chen Ji took a deep breath, both hands solemnly accepting the token. The moment it touched his palm, a warmth transmitted from the token into his palm, as if something was resonating with his incomplete Tianji Record within. He raised his head to express gratitude, yet discovered the old man's form had begun fading and becoming translucent, like morning mist dispersed by sunlight. 'Elder—'

dialogue.content: (The old man's voice gradually faded away) Cause and effect cycle, fate has its own course. Our fate isn't exhausted—you will meet again naturally. Remember—the threat of the Eyes of Heaven is far more terrifying than you imagine. Until you are strong enough, absolutely do not proactively provoke them.

text.content: Once the words fell, the old man had completely dissolved between heaven and earth, as if never existing. Mountain wind still blew, clouds and mist still drifted—only the heavy token in his palm silently spoke of something. Chen Ji stared blankly at the direction where the elder vanished, speechless for a long while. Mr. Mo's voice rang out in his Mental Sea, carrying a rare weight: 'Chen Ji, do you understand what this means? For someone from Tianji Pavilion to proactively appear—this means... you have been drawn into a chess game far vaster than mere sect struggles.'

Chen Ji slowly clenched the token tighter, his knuckles whitening from the force. He raised his gaze toward the horizon, his eyes deep and dark as an abyss. Tianji Pavilion, the protective spirit beast's warning, the Eyes of Heaven, Chen Nian's disappearance... all the clues like scattered puzzle pieces were gradually assembling into a picture he dared not contemplate in detail. 'I understand.' He spoke lowly, his voice abnormallycalm. 'From the moment I obtained the Tianji Record, I was already within this局.' He turned toward Tianqing Sect, his figure bleak yet笔直like a sword. 'But it doesn't matter.' He murmured, the corner of his lips curving into a profound弧度. 'Since it's a chess game, then I shall become the Chess Player.'
